description:
The defect is one predicate. `parseSerializedParam` in `code/core/src/manager-api/modules/url.ts:42-50` ends with `.filter(([key, value]) => key && value)`; an empty-string value is falsy, so the whole pair — key included — is thrown away. `mergeSerializedParams` (lines 52-58) is built on it and is what `getStoryHrefs` uses for `args` (line 282) and `globals` (line 285) when inheriting, so the link "Open in isolation mode" opens silently loses every argument a person deliberately emptied. Everything on either side of that filter already handles the empty string: `buildArgsParam` serializes `{ label: '' }` to `label:`, `buildNavigationUrl` filters only null and undefined, and the preview's `parseArgsParam` turns `label:` back into `{ label: '' }`.

The approach is to narrow the predicate to the key alone — a pair is discarded only when its key is empty, which keeps `''`, `';'` and `':x'` producing no pair at all and so keeps a bare `:` out of every built link — and to do it where forge can test it. The two helpers move, unchanged apart from that predicate, into `code/core/src/manager-api/lib/url.ts`, the dependency-free module `modules/url.ts` already imports `buildNavigationUrl` from; `mergeSerializedParams` becomes its exported surface and `parseSerializedParam` stays private to it. That move is what makes a unit test possible: the only runner forge has here is the Playwright config at `code/e2e-internal/playwright.config.ts`, which cannot load `modules/url.ts` (it pulls in `storybook/internal/*`, `@storybook/global` and `picoquery`) but can import by relative path a module that imports nothing. One task carries the whole change, because the whole change is that predicate.

What this deliberately leaves alone: the serialized shape of `args` (pairs joined by `;`, key and value joined by `:`, values URI-encoded exactly as today), `buildArgsParam`, `buildNavigationUrl`, the preview-side parser, the toolbar button and its registration, the keyboard and clipboard paths, and the expectations in `code/core/src/manager-api/tests/url.test.js`, which stay at their current values rather than being relaxed around the fix.
out_of_scope: Globals. Empty-string globals travel through the same helper and improve with it, since `getStoryHrefs` merges `globals` through the same call; that is accepted but no criterion asserts it and no separate work is done for it.

The keyboard shortcut and "copy story link". `openInIsolation` and `copyStoryLink` in `code/core/src/manager-api/modules/shortcuts.ts` use the same call and benefit, but clipboard and keyboard paths get no test here.
Composed Storybooks (`refId`) and the main preview iframe. Their behaviour must not change and nothing asserts it; `refId` handling in `getStoryHrefs` is untouched.
Other falsy values. `0`, `false`, `!null` and `!undefined` keep their existing encodings, and a pair written without a `:` keeps exactly what it produces today (`abc` stays `abc:undefined`).
Any change to the `args` URL format, to `buildArgsParam` (`code/core/src/router/utils.ts`), to `buildNavigationUrl`, or to the preview-side `parseArgsParam`.
Controls-panel behaviour: how a person clears a control, and the warning about unsafe URL args, are unchanged.
No new option, no new UI, no change to the "Open in isolation mode" button or to how args are written into the address bar.

No new vitest cases in `code/core/src/manager-api/tests/url.test.js`. forge's suite is Playwright and cannot collect vitest, so that file is forbidden to the task and its expectations stay exactly as they are.
No new stories or fixtures in product code. The tests use the internal Storybook's existing `core-basics--basic` and `controls-basics--defined` as they are.
No change to `scripts/forge-e2e-internal.sh`, `forge.yaml`, `code/e2e-internal/playwright.config.ts` or `code/e2e-internal/helpers.ts`, and no new service, account or network access.
Pair order inside the built `args` parameter is not asserted. The manager rewrites the address bar from the story's own argument order, so links are compared as sets of pairs.
rollback_plan: On the run branch the work lands as task 001's `tests:` commit followed by its one or more `build:` commits, on top of the `acceptance:` commit that holds `code/e2e-internal/isolation-mode-empty-args.spec.ts` and the `forge:` commit that holds this plan. To undo before the pull request merges, revert task 001's `build:` commits newest first, then its `tests:` commit: that removes `code/e2e-internal/unit/serialized-params.spec.ts` and puts `parseSerializedParam` and `mergeSerializedParams` back inside `code/core/src/manager-api/modules/url.ts` with the `key && value` filter, leaving `code/core/src/manager-api/lib/url.ts` with `buildNavigationUrl` alone. To undo after the pull request has merged, revert its merge commit (`git revert -m 1 <merge sha>`), which takes the acceptance commit, the plan commit and the task's commits back out together. The change is confined to those commits: no data is migrated, no configuration, dependency or service is touched, and nothing is cached or persisted outside the repository, so reverting is the whole of the rollback.

tasks.definition_of_done:
`code/core/src/manager-api/lib/url.ts` exports `mergeSerializedParams(params: string, extraParams: string): string` beside the existing `buildNavigationUrl`. It splits each `;`-separated pair of both arguments on `:`, URI-encodes the value as the current code does, discards a pair only when its key is empty, lets a key present in `extraParams` override the same key from `params`, and joins the result back with `;`. So `'label:'` round-trips to `'label:'`, `'text:;radio:'` keeps both pairs, `''`, `';'` and `':x'` each yield no pair and therefore no bare `:` in any built link, `'equal:g=h'` still yields `'equal:g%3Dh'`, and `'abc'` still yields `'abc:undefined'`. `parseSerializedParam` is private to that module.

`code/core/src/manager-api/modules/url.ts` no longer defines either helper: it extends its existing `import { buildNavigationUrl } from '../lib/url.ts'` to bring in `mergeSerializedParams`, and `getStoryHrefs` calls it exactly as before for both `args` and `globals`, with the rest of the function unchanged.

The unit spec is a new file under the task's test root (`code/e2e-internal/unit/serialized-params.spec.ts`) and reaches the helper at call time rather than through a static import, so that at the `tests:` commit — where the export does not exist yet — every one of its tests fails on an `expect`, not on a module error: `const mod = await import('../../core/src/manager-api/lib/url.ts').catch(() => ({}))`, then `const mergeSerializedParams = (mod as any).mergeSerializedParams ?? (() => undefined)`, and each test asserts on what that call returns.

Green state: every test collected by `code/e2e-internal/unit/serialized-params.spec.ts` passes, and all five tests of `code/e2e-internal/isolation-mode-empty-args.spec.ts` pass. AC-05 in that file is the invariant guard — it passes before this task and must still pass after, with the opened tab carrying no `args` parameter and no pair starting with `:` anywhere in its query. The expectations in `code/core/src/manager-api/tests/url.test.js` are not edited.
tasks.intent: Move the serialized-param merge into `code/core/src/manager-api/lib/url.ts` as an exported `mergeSerializedParams` that keeps a pair whose value is an empty string and still discards a pair whose key is empty, and have `getStoryHrefs` call it.
produces: mergeSerializedParams(params: string, extraParams: string): string, exported from code/core/src/manager-api/lib/url.ts
